subject: pol-dy
title: POL.DY.------PROG.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 293 (PR.S(RD)II-47), paired with STF × ACT above. The crossing diagrams how political-dynamics structurally meets progressional-continuance at the western-mis-definition scale that the following prose names: 'the realness of western mis-definitions has so profoundly altered our understanding of creative participation that something must be...' POL-DY (political dynamics — the actual political-working that the western definers' apparatus runs) crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance — the form's actual continuance the apparatus is supposed to receive). POL-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TRS (transition) at upper-right, branching from the main line, and RT-DY (reality dynamics) below, branching from TRS's line. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) sits centrally, branching from the main line; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) at center-right branches from SOC-RT-DY's line, and PROG-CONT below holds the partner-axis position. INFO-DY (information dynamics) hangs at left and (R)DOC (the reality of documentation) below as the subject-side downward chain. RTD-PRD (related procedure) sits at the bottom-center, branching from (R)DOC's line, and PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) with POL-OR (political order) sits at the bottom-right, PHY-U-P branching from RT-ALGN's line and POL-OR from PHY-U-P's line. Structural argument: when political-dynamics is crossed with progressional-continuance, the upper diagonal POL-DY → TRS → RT-DY is the *upper route* — political-dynamics routes directly through transition into reality-dynamics, the western definers' working chain. SOC-RT-DY hub holds the bridging diagonal: social-reality dynamics routes through RT-ALGN into PHY-U-P and POL-OR. The subject's INFO-DY → (R)DOC chain on the left is what political-dynamics produces alone — information-dynamics routes through the reality of documentation.
